SPY.title: Wall Street Futures Show Weakness As Investors Look To Lock In Gains After Strong Post-Election Rally: 'Bull Market Sentiment Remains Intact,' Says Wharton Economist
SPY.description: US stock futures are trading lower on Tuesday as investors look to lock in gains after a strong post-election rally. Experts say the bull market sentiment remains intact, with small-cap and cyclical stocks expected to continue outperforming.
SPY.author: Rounak Jain
